category: MATLAB Coder, GPU Coder & HDL Coder II > Code Generation Directives, Types, External Code, Build Info & HDL from MATLAB
description: Code generation functions not covered by the basic entries (codegen, coder.typeof, coder.varsize, coder.extrinsic, coder.ceval, coder.config): inlining/unrolling/constant-folding directives, type and constant specifications, external C/C++ integration helpers, build-information and packaging utilities, hardware/GPU configuration, and HDL Coder functions and pragmas for generating HDL from MATLAB.

tools.name: coder.inline
tools.description: Directive placed inside a function to control whether the code generator inlines that function at its call sites ('always', 'never' or 'default' heuristics). Inlining removes call overhead; preventing it keeps generated code modular and readable.
tools.notes: coder.inlineCall and coder.nonInlineCall control inlining at a specific call site instead. Has no effect in MATLAB execution.

tools.name: coder.inlineCall
tools.description: Inlines one specific call to a function in the generated code, overriding the callee's coder.inline setting only at that call site.

parameters.name: functionCall
parameters.description: The call expression, e.g. myFcn(a, b).

tools.notes: Introduced R2022a together with coder.nonInlineCall.

tools.name: coder.const
tools.description: Forces an expression to be evaluated at code generation time and folded into a constant in the generated code, e.g. building lookup tables or configuration structures once instead of at run time.
tools.usage:
out = coder.const(expression)
[out1, ..., outN] = coder.const(handle, arg1, ..., argN)

parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: Expression whose value must be computable at compile time.

parameters.name: handle, args
parameters.description: Function handle and constant arguments for multi-output evaluation.

tools.notes: Errors if the value depends on run-time inputs. coder.mustBeConst validates that an input argument is constant (R2023b+).

tools.name: coder.unroll
tools.description: Unrolls a for-loop in generated code by copying the loop body for each iteration, which can improve speed for short loops with constant bounds.
tools.usage:
for i = coder.unroll(range) ... end
for i = coder.unroll(range, flag) ... end

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Loop range with compile-time constant bounds.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: Logical constant; false disables unrolling (useful for parametrized code).

tools.notes: Large unrolled loops increase code size. HDL Coder uses coder.hdl.loopspec for similar control in hardware.

tools.name: coder.nullcopy
tools.description: Declares a variable without initializing its contents in generated code, avoiding unnecessary memory writes when every element will be assigned before use.

parameters.name: A
parameters.description: Array defining the size, class and complexity of X.

tools.notes: Reading an element before assigning it gives undefined results in generated code (MATLAB still initializes it).

tools.name: coder.target
tools.description: Returns true when code is being generated for the specified target (e.g. "MATLAB", "MEX", "C", "C++", "CUDA", "HDL"), letting one function contain target-specific branches.
tools.notes: Branches for other targets are removed at compile time.

tools.name: coder.load
tools.description: Loads variables from a MAT-file or ASCII file at code generation time and embeds them as constants in the generated code, e.g. filter coefficients or trained model parameters.
tools.usage:
S = coder.load(filename)
S = coder.load(filename, var1, ..., varN)

parameters.name: var1...varN
parameters.description: Variable names to load (wildcards and -regexp supported).

tools.notes: Changes to the MAT-file require regeneration. Use load for run-time loading where supported.

tools.name: coder.newtype
tools.description: Creates a coder.Type object describing an entry-point input from class, size and variable-size flags without needing an example value, for use with codegen -args.
tools.usage:
t = coder.newtype(numericClass, sz, variableDims)
t = coder.newtype(numericClass, sz, variableDims, Name=Value)
t = coder.newtype("struct", structFields, sz, variableDims)

parameters.name: sz / variableDims
parameters.description: Upper-bound size and logical vector of variable dimensions.

tools.example:
t = coder.newtype("double", [1 Inf], [0 1]);      % 1-by-:Inf row vector
codegen myFcn -args {t, coder.newtype("int32", [1 1], [0 0])}
tools.notes: coder.typeof builds types from example values; coder.resize changes size/variability of existing types.

tools.name: coder.Constant
tools.description: Specifies that an entry-point input is a compile-time constant with a given value, so the generated function has no corresponding argument and the value is folded into the code.
tools.example: codegen myFFT -args {zeros(1024,1), coder.Constant(1024)} -config:lib
tools.notes: The generated function signature omits constant inputs. Also used in buildInstrumentedMex and fiaccel -args.

tools.name: coder.ignoreConst
tools.description: Prevents the code generator from using the constant value of an argument expression to create specialized copies of a called function, reducing code size when a function is called with many different constants.

parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: Argument expression whose constant value should be ignored.

tools.example:
function y = entry(x) %#codegen
y = scale(x, coder.ignoreConst(2)) + scale(x, coder.ignoreConst(3));   % one specialization
end
tools.notes: coder.ignoreSize similarly prevents specializations based on constant sizes.

tools.name: coder.ref
tools.description: Indicates that an argument of coder.ceval is passed by reference (as a pointer) to external C/C++ code, which may read and modify it. coder.rref (read-only) and coder.wref (write-only) are the restricted variants.

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: Variable (or element) to pass by reference.

parameters.name: "gpu"
parameters.description: Optional flag to pass GPU memory pointers (GPU Coder).

tools.notes: Pair with coder.updateBuildInfo or codegen command-line source files to compile the external function.

tools.name: coder.cinclude
tools.description: Adds an #include directive for a C/C++ header to the generated code, required when calling external functions or using external types via coder.ceval and coder.opaque.

parameters.name: InAllSourceFiles
parameters.description: Include in all generated source files (default only where called).

tools.notes: Header search paths are added with coder.updateBuildInfo("addIncludePaths", ...) or codegen -I.

tools.name: coder.opaque
tools.description: Declares a variable of an external C type (e.g. FILE*, a struct handle or time_t) in generated code, whose value is only manipulated by external functions.
tools.usage:
y = coder.opaque(type)
y = coder.opaque(type, value)
y = coder.opaque(type, value, "HeaderFile", headerfile)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: C type name as a string.

tools.notes: MATLAB cannot inspect opaque values; use coder.target to provide MATLAB-side behavior.

tools.name: coder.cstructname
tools.description: Names the C structure type generated for a MATLAB structure, or maps it to an existing externally defined struct type from a header, so generated code interfaces cleanly with hand-written C.
tools.usage:
coder.cstructname(var, structName)
coder.cstructname(var, structName, "extern", "HeaderFile", headerfile)
t = coder.cstructname(t, structName)

parameters.name: var / t
parameters.description: Structure variable inside a function, or a coder.StructType at the command line.

parameters.name: "extern"
parameters.description: Use an externally defined type rather than generating one.

tools.notes: Field order and types must match the external definition exactly.

tools.name: coder.updateBuildInfo
tools.description: Called from MATLAB code for code generation, it adds source files, include paths, libraries, defines or compile/link flags to the build information so external code is compiled and linked with the generated code.
tools.usage:
coder.updateBuildInfo("addSourceFiles", srcfile)
coder.updateBuildInfo("addIncludePaths", path)
coder.updateBuildInfo("addLinkObjects", filename, path, priority, precompiled, linkonly)
coder.updateBuildInfo("addDefines", macros)

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Arguments of the build information method.

tools.notes: For reusable integrations implement a coder.ExternalDependency class instead.

tools.name: coder.ExternalDependency
tools.description: Abstract class for packaging an interface to external C/C++ code: it declares build dependencies (updateBuildInfo) and exposes MATLAB-callable static methods that wrap coder.ceval, so callers do not deal with build details.
tools.usage:
classdef myLibAPI < coder.ExternalDependency
    methods (Static)
        function name = getDescriptiveName(context) ... end
        function tf = isSupportedContext(context) ... end
        function updateBuildInfo(buildInfo, context) ... end
        function y = compute(x) ... end
    end
end

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: coder.BuildConfig object describing the build (target language, toolchain).

tools.example:
% in generated-code entry point:
function y = entry(x) %#codegen
y = myLibAPI.compute(x);
end
tools.notes: Inside compute, branch with coder.target("MATLAB") to provide a MATLAB implementation for simulation.

tools.name: coder.screener
tools.description: Analyzes MATLAB files and their callees for code generation readiness, reporting unsupported functions and language features before you attempt codegen.
tools.notes: Opens the Code Generation Readiness report when no output is requested.

tools.name: coder.getArgTypes
tools.description: Determines the input types of an entry-point function by running a test file or function and recording the arguments passed, returning coder.Type objects for codegen -args.
tools.usage:
types = coder.getArgTypes(testFcn, fcn)
types = coder.getArgTypes(testFcn, {fcn1, ..., fcnN})
types = coder.getArgTypes(___, "uniform", true)

parameters.name: testFcn
parameters.description: Test script/function that calls the entry point.

tools.example:
types = coder.getArgTypes("test_myFilter", "myFilter");
codegen myFilter -args types -config:lib
tools.notes: Types are fixed-size unless the test exercises different sizes; adjust with coder.resize.

tools.name: packNGo
tools.description: Packages generated code files, required headers, sources and libraries (from the build information) into a ZIP file so the code can be relocated, unpacked and rebuilt in another development environment.

parameters.name: buildInfo
parameters.description: RTW.BuildInfo object (loaded from codegen/<target>/<fcn>/buildInfo.mat) or result of a build.

parameters.name: fileName / minimalHeaders / includeReport
parameters.description: ZIP name, header minimization and report inclusion.

tools.notes: Alternatively set cfg.PostCodeGenCommand = 'packNGo(buildInfo)' to package automatically after generation.

tools.name: coder.hardware
tools.description: Creates a hardware configuration object for a supported target board (e.g. Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson/DRIVE) to assign to the Hardware property of a code configuration, enabling on-target build, deployment and PIL.

parameters.name: boardName
parameters.description: Supported board name, e.g. "Raspberry Pi", "NVIDIA Jetson", "NVIDIA Drive".

tools.notes: Requires the corresponding hardware support package; call coder.hardware() to list installed boards.

tools.name: coder.gpuConfig
tools.description: Creates a GPU Coder configuration object (coder.GpuCodeConfig inside a MEX/lib/dll/exe config) for generating CUDA code from MATLAB, with GPU-specific options such as compute capability, memory manager and cuDNN/TensorRT libraries.
tools.usage:
cfg = coder.gpuConfig
cfg = coder.gpuConfig(buildType)
cfg = coder.gpuConfig(buildType, "ecoder", true)
tools.notes: Requires GPU Coder and a CUDA toolkit; coder.checkGpuInstall verifies the environment. Use coder.gpu.kernelfun / gpucoder.* pragmas to guide kernel creation.

tools.name: coder.EmbeddedCodeConfig
tools.description: Configuration object for C/C++ code generation with Embedded Coder, adding production-code options (code style, identifier naming, comments, code replacement libraries, SIL/PIL verification) on top of coder.CodeConfig.
tools.notes: Requires Embedded Coder. coder.CodeConfig is the MATLAB Coder-only equivalent created by coder.config("lib").

tools.name: coder.HdlConfig
tools.description: HDL code generation configuration object for generating Verilog/VHDL (or HLS C++) from MATLAB functions with HDL Coder, including test bench generation, target language, clocking, optimization and synthesis tool settings. Created with coder.config("hdl").

parameters.name: SynthesisTool / TargetFrequency
parameters.description: FPGA synthesis tool (Vivado, Quartus, ...) and clock target.

tools.notes: Floating-point designs are converted to fixed point with a coder.FixPtConfig (-float2fixed) or use native floating point. The MATLAB HDL Workflow Advisor offers the same steps interactively.

tools.name: hdlsetuptoolpath
tools.description: Adds an FPGA synthesis tool (AMD Vivado, Intel Quartus, Microchip Libero, Lattice) to the system path for the current MATLAB session so HDL Coder workflows can run synthesis and implementation.

parameters.name: ToolName
parameters.description: E.g. "Xilinx Vivado", "Altera QUARTUS II", "Intel Quartus Pro", "Microchip Libero SoC".

parameters.name: ToolPath
parameters.description: Full path to the tool executable.

tools.example:
hdlsetuptoolpath("ToolName", "Xilinx Vivado", ...
    "ToolPath", "C:/Xilinx/Vivado/2024.2/bin/vivado.bat");
tools.notes: Call in startup.m to persist across sessions. Check supported tool versions for your MATLAB release.

tools.name: hdlfimath
tools.description: Returns the recommended fimath for HDL code generation (floor rounding, wrap overflow, full-precision products and sums), which yields the most hardware-efficient arithmetic.
tools.notes: Use with setfimath in fixed-point MATLAB designs intended for HDL Coder.

tools.name: hdl.RAM
tools.description: System object modeling single-port, simple dual-port or dual-port RAM for HDL code generation from MATLAB, mapping to inferred block RAM in FPGAs.
tools.usage:
ram = hdl.RAM(Name=Value)
dataOut = ram(dataIn, addr, writeEnable)

parameters.name: RAMType
parameters.description: "Single port", "Simple dual port", "Dual port" or "True dual port".

parameters.name: WriteOutputValue / RAMInitialValue
parameters.description: Read-during-write behavior ("New data"/"Old data") and initial contents.

tools.notes: Address type determines depth (e.g. ufi with 10 bits -> 1024 words). Persistent arrays can also map to RAM with the MapPersistentVarsToRAM option.

tools.name: coder.hdl.pipeline
tools.description: HDL Coder pragma that inserts a specified number of pipeline registers at the output of a MATLAB expression in the generated HDL, to break long combinational paths and raise clock frequency.

parameters.name: expr
parameters.description: MATLAB expression whose output is registered.

tools.notes: Cannot be applied to expressions involving persistent state in feedback loops. Enable distributed pipelining to balance inserted registers.

tools.name: coder.hdl.loopspec
tools.description: HDL Coder pragma that controls how the next for-loop is implemented in HDL: fully unrolled into parallel hardware or streamed to reuse one copy of the loop body over multiple clock cycles (and pipelined in HLS flows).
tools.usage:
coder.hdl.loopspec("unroll")
coder.hdl.loopspec("unroll", unrollFactor)
coder.hdl.loopspec("stream")
coder.hdl.loopspec("stream", streamFactor)

parameters.name: "unroll" / "stream"
parameters.description: Implementation strategy for the following loop.

tools.notes: Place the pragma immediately before the loop. Streaming trades throughput for area.

tools.name: makehdl
tools.description: Generates synthesizable VHDL, Verilog or SystemVerilog code for a Simulink model or subsystem with HDL Coder, applying HDL block properties and model-level optimization settings.

parameters.name: dut
parameters.description: Path of the subsystem (or model) to generate HDL for.

tools.example:
load_system("sfir_fixed")
makehdl("sfir_fixed/symmetric_fir", "TargetLanguage", "Verilog", ...
    "TargetDirectory", "hdlsrc", "ResourceReport", "on");
makehdltb("sfir_fixed/symmetric_fir")
tools.notes: Run checkhdl first to find incompatibilities. hdlset_param sets HDL parameters on models; makehdltb generates test benches; the HDL Workflow Advisor (hdladvisor) covers synthesis and FPGA deployment.

tools.name: hdlset_param
tools.description: Sets HDL-related parameters on a Simulink model or on individual blocks/subsystems (e.g. target language, clock settings, pipelining, sharing, architecture) that makehdl uses during code generation.
tools.notes: Settings are saved with the model. hdlsaveparams exports nondefault HDL settings as a script.
